messages:
nick-sales: Quick sync 80s Prospect 'Crestline' wants a 3-week POC. Core asks: SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning + group sync, RBAC mapping, domain ownership, and a security questionnaire. Need concise runbook + two pricing options.

 talia-solutions: Got it. We do SAML 2.0 (IdP/SP-init). We'll need IdP metadata XML and the public signing cert. Persistent NameID (email) supported. Do they expect encrypted assertions or just signed?

 nick-sales: They prefer encrypted assertions and signed responses. Also require audience restriction to our SP entityID and recipient matching ACS.

 rene-eng: We support signed assertions (RSA-SHA256) and AES-encrypted assertions. On Hosted, assertion encryption is supported but key upload must go through our Console with a rotation window. For Dedicated/Private we can accept direct key exchange and mTLS for everything.

 carmen-security: Security checklist: cert thumbprint, NameID format, required attributes, assertion encryption yes/no, SCIM auth method, token rotation cadence, IP allowlist for SCIM calls, compliance docs. We'll provide our questionnaire PDF and link: https://redwood.ai/security/sso-scim.

 talia-solutions: SCIM: we implement SCIM 2.0 with /scim/v2/Users and /scim/v2/Groups. PATCH is supported for group membership. Bulk users up to 200 per request on Hosted. Note: group delta is eventually consistent; changes propagate to session caches in ~3-10s.

 nick-sales: They want multiple IdP groups collapsed into a single role (e.g., ledger-team + auditors -> viewer). What's simplest for POC?

 rene-eng: Easiest: provision groups via SCIM and map group.displayName -> Redwood role in Console mapping. Alternative: include redwood:role as an attribute in SAML and map server-side. For POC, SCIM groups are more flexible since admins can change mapping without IdP changes.

 talia-solutions: We'll include sample mapping in runbook and a small script to create groups + assign users. Also propose starter roles: viewer, editor, admin, billing.

 carmen-security: Domain controls: we support DNS TXT verification plus optional email confirm. For strict tenancy they can enable enforced email domain allowlist and disable invite-by-email. If they require wildcard domain blocks, we can add custom deny lists on Dedicated.

 ops-bot: [automated] Ticket CREATED: CREST-POC-2207  Attachments: SAML-SCIM-checklist.

 nick-sales: Pricing ask: need hosted per-call estimate vs Dedicated reserved seat. They expect 200 users in POC and maybe 2k in production.

 talia-solutions: Quick pricing bullets: Hosted: $X/month base + $Y per-active-user/month + provisioning call metering (per-1000 calls). Dedicated: monthly reserved capacity (includes provisioning allowance) + overage per extra calls. I'll draft sample cost for 200 and 2k users.

 rene-eng: Rate limits: Hosted SCIM default 10 req/s tenant with burst 50; bulk endpoints reduce call count. For sustained higher throughput recommend Dedicated. Also note: on Hosted session cache TTL is ~45s for role caches; group changes may take that long to propagate to live auth checks.

 carmen-security: For security questionnaire answers I'll include: TLS1.2+, signed assertions RSA-SHA256, SCIM over HTTPS with OAuth bearer by default, mTLS available for Dedicated/Private, token rotation recommended 90 days, IP allowlist supported for Dedicated.

 nick-sales: Action items: @rene-eng write 1-page runbook with ACS/entityID, sample SAML attribute mapping, SCIM examples, and group->role mapping snippet; @carmen-security complete questionnaire answers; @talia-solutions draft pricing bullets and a small cost calculator. Target: 48hrs. I'll send to buyer after review.

 rene-eng: Adding small SCIM example for runbook:

```
POST /scim/v2/Users
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "userName": "alex@crestline.com",
  "name": {"givenName":"Alex","familyName":"Rivera"},
  "emails": [{"value":"alex@crestline.com","primary":true}],
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"]
}
```

 rene-eng: And sample group PATCH for mapping:

```
PATCH /scim/v2/Groups/47a2b
[ {"op":"add","path":"members","value":[{"value":"user-472"}]} ]
```

 carmen-security: Sample SAML attribute snippet we recommend sending in metadata exchange:

```
<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name=\"urn:oid:0.9.2342.19200300.100.1.3\">
    <AttributeValue>user@example.com</AttributeValue>
  </Attribute>
  <Attribute Name=\"redwood:role\">
    <AttributeValue>viewer</AttributeValue>
  </Attribute>
</AttributeStatement>
```

 talia-solutions: I'll prepare the pricing bullets and attach a one-page runbook draft.

 nick-sales: Perfect. I'll coordinate with buyer to get IdP metadata and a test tenant. Reopen thread when we have metadata. Thanks all :thumbsup:
